name: Amazon Redshift - Audit - Connection Log Analysis - New
description: See information about database connections, including authentication failure counts and trends; session statistics and details; and top remote hosts, users, databases, and applications.
title: Amazon Redshift - Audit - Connection Log Analysis - New

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/Redshift/Audit* ("authenticated" or "authentication failure" or "initiating session" or "connecting session" or "disconnecting session" or "set application_name" or "Terminating backend on administrator")
| parse regex "^(?<event>[\w]+[\w\s]*)\|(?<eventDetails>.*)"
| parse "*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*" as event, recordtime, remotehost, remoteport, pid, dbname, username, authmethod, duration, sslversion, sslcipher, mtu, sslcompression, sslexpansion, something1, application_name
| if (authmethod matches "password*", "password", if (authmethod matches "Ident*", "Ident", authmethod)) as authmethod
| timeslice 1h
|where if ("{{dbname}}" = "*", true, dbname matches "{{dbname}}") AND if ("{{username}}" = "*", true, username matches "{{username}}") AND if ("{{event}}" = "*", true, event matches "{{event}}") AND if ("{{sslversion}}" = "*", true, sslversion matches "{{sslversion}}") AND if ("{{authmethod}}" = "*", true, authmethod matches "{{authmethod}}") AND if ("{{remotehost}}" = "*", true, remotehost matches "{{remotehost}}") AND if ("{{remoteport}}" = "*", true, remoteport matches "{{remoteport}}") AND if ("{{application_name}}" = "*", true, application_name matches "{{application_name}}") AND if ("{{pid}}" = "*", true, pid matches "{{pid}}") AND if ("{{sslcipher}}" = "*", true, sslcipher matches "{{sslcipher}}")
|count as %"Requests" by _timeslice, authmethod
| transpose row _timeslice column authmethod

_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/Redshift/Audit* ("authenticated" or "authentication failure" or "initiating session" or "connecting session" or "disconnecting session" or "set application_name" or "Terminating backend on administrator")

| parse regex field = dbname "(?<dbname>[^\s]+)\s*" nodrop
|where if ("{{dbname}}" = "*", true, dbname matches "{{dbname}}") AND if ("{{username}}" = "*", true, username matches "{{username}}") AND if ("{{event}}" = "*", true, event matches "{{event}}") AND if ("{{sslversion}}" = "*", true, sslversion matches "{{sslversion}}") AND if ("{{authmethod}}" = "*", true, authmethod matches "{{authmethod}}") AND if ("{{remotehost}}" = "*", true, remotehost matches "{{remotehost}}") AND if ("{{remoteport}}" = "*", true, remoteport matches "{{remoteport}}") AND if ("{{application_name}}" = "*", true, application_name matches "{{application_name}}") AND if ("{{pid}}" = "*", true, pid matches "{{pid}}") AND if ("{{sslcipher}}" = "*", true, sslcipher matches "{{sslcipher}}")
|count as %"Requests" by dbname
| top 10 dbname by %"Requests", dbname asc

| parse regex "^(?<event>[\w]+[\w\s]*)\|(?<eventDetails>.*)"
| parse "*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*" as event, recordtime, remotehost, remoteport, pid, dbname, username, authmethod, duration, sslversion, sslcipher, mtu, sslcompression, sslexpansion, something1, application_name
